notes.title: Ho-Ho-Ho-Hotfix
notes.content:
Some quite fun, yet gamebreaking bugs occurred so i made myself a tea, ate some cookies and patched them out.

Bugs fixed:

 Buying cookies/hot chocolate while other player entered the trigger led to player1 buying player2 cookies/ hot chocolate.
 Always dropped a gift when turned into snowman
 Hot chocolate removed freeze visually but not server wise which led to an instant refreeze after consuming hot chocolate and getting hit by a snowball


Adjustments

 Snowball flies faster
 PickUp animation faster
 Area in front of furnace now "snowfree"

notes.title: Àrengard - Christmas Update
notes.content:
Ho Ho Ho Àrengard - Christmas is here:

New Party Mode GIFT HUNT:
Collect gifts and fight your friends in order to become Santa of the month

New Unlockables GLASSES:
Unlock up to 6 new glasses while playing Gift Hunt

More is on the way......
